start: GitHub Actions page, workflow 'Device QA (Android emulator)'

steps.action: Press 'Run workflow' with every box empty, api 34, profile default
user_sees: Run named 'Device QA (Android emulator)'
must_not: A whole run named partial, so the gate ignores it

steps.action: Job plan lists canary, affected parts and shards; job build makes one APK
user_sees: 'affected parts: ...' and 'APK sha256 <hash>'
must_not: Each shard building its own APK

steps.action: Every shard checks the APK hash, then runs its parts with fail-fast
user_sees: 'device-qa (<shard>)' jobs; the first red cancels the rest
must_not: 'This shard's APK is not the one built for this run.' ignored
A round running on for hours after a red part

steps.action: Job report checks every shard green and every part run
user_sees: Step 'Every shard green, every part run'; artifact 'qa-out' kept 30 days
must_not: A green run when a part never ran

start: Run the device test on the owner's phone profile

steps.action: Choose profile owner
user_sees: Run named 'Device QA (owner phone, api 34)'
must_not: The owner run named so the gate cannot find it

steps.action: Type 'u461' in 'only'
user_sees: Run named 'Device QA (partial u461, api 34, profile default)'; one piece
must_not: A partial run opening the release gate

steps.action: Choose api 35
user_sees: Run named 'Device QA (partial whole run, api 35, profile default)'
must_not: A non-34 run counted by the release gate

steps.action: A shard fails
user_sees: '::error::A shard failed (see its summary).' in job report
must_not: Job report green

start: A red round fixed and finished

steps.action: Start a newer whole run on the same branch, phone and API
user_sees: The older run cancelled
must_not: Two whole runs of the same phone at once

steps.action: Re-run the failed and cancelled jobs after fixing a phone-test file
user_sees: Green shards keep their evidence; job report checks all of them again
must_not: Green shards' evidence lost on re-run

steps.action: Step 'QA-only stand-ins in app.json' adds qaStandIns to this test build only
user_sees: Made-up answers that say on screen they are test data; a stand-in store that takes no money
must_not: Stand-ins in a store or GitHub release build
A real payment taken by the test

start: A v* tag's release run reaches its phone gate

steps.action: The phone gate looks for a passing whole API 34 run of this workflow on the tagged commit or its parent, on both profiles
user_sees: Runs named 'Device QA (Android emulator...)' and 'Device QA (owner phone, api 34...)' found green
must_not: A partial run accepted
A run on another commit accepted

start: A later release workflow calls this one with uses:

steps.action: workflow_call starts the device test
user_sees: The run recorded under the caller's workflow name
must_not: The gate looking for the run under this file's name and not finding it

start: Release tagged with no owner-profile whole run

steps.action: The phone gate finds only the default-profile run
user_sees: unknown: gate words not read (scripts/ci/phone_gate.py)
must_not: The release built without the owner-profile run

start: The whole run is cancelled by a newer one

steps.action: A newer whole run starts on the same branch and profile
user_sees: The older run cancelled
must_not: The cancelled run counted as passing by the gate
